verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a built-in AI assistant that answers based on your notes and can propose creates and updates. It also summarizes or rewrites selected blocks. For data controls, AI is fully opt-in and you can pass specific blocks or notes as chat context, but finer-grained limits on what the assistant can see are not documented. missing for 10: granular controls to scope or exclude which notes and spaces the AI can access beyond the global opt-in and manually passed context, explicit documentation of note-grounded drafting, independent or hands-on corroboration of answer quality and grounding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, a built-in AI assistant can answer questions, summarize, and draft grounded in my own notes — with clear controls over what data it sees

citations.quote: The AI answers based on your notes, can plan multi-step work, and can propose creates and updates for you to approve.
After selecting blocks in your content, you can quickly launch the AI panel to perform tasks such as translation, rewriting, or summarization.
You can pass blocks or notes as context.
AI features in Capacities are fully opt-in. If you do not activate AI, no data from your spaces is shared with any third-party AI services
